companyIntroduction: Realjet develops project-specific equipment for precast concrete production and infrastructure construction. Our scope can connect process planning, mechanical design, steel fabrication, hydraulic or mechanical integration, workshop assembly, installation support and commissioning around the customer's production objective. Final dimensions, functions, interfaces and delivery boundaries are confirmed through technical review before manufacturing.

categories.name: Bridge & Transportation Moulds
categories.description: Project-specific steel mould systems for precast bridge, viaduct and rail components produced in permanent factories or dedicated casting yards.

categories.name: Building Component Moulds
categories.description: Steel mould systems for repeat production of structural and architectural components used in residential, commercial and industrial buildings.

categories.name: Tunnel & Underground Moulds
categories.description: Purpose-designed mould systems for tunnel linings, culverts and other precast components installed below ground.

categories.name: Municipal & Infrastructure Moulds
categories.description: Mould systems for drainage, utility, road and civil-infrastructure components manufactured in controlled precast operations.

categories.name: Custom Precast Moulds
categories.description: Made-to-drawing mould systems for component families, non-standard geometry and project-specific operating sequences.

products.title: Beam and Girder Moulds
products.description: Steel mould systems configured for repeated production of precast T-, I-, U-, trough and other project-defined beams or girders.
products.application: Beam and girder moulds are used in precast factories and project casting yards serving highways, urban viaducts, rail infrastructure and industrial construction. The mould arrangement is developed from the approved cross-section, length range, reinforcement and embedded-item layout, prestressing method where applicable, casting sequence and component-handling plan.
performance: Bottom, side and end forms configured to the approved component geometry
Stiffened support frames and defined locking positions based on the mould design basis
Replaceable end forms or inserts for an approved family of related components
Manual, mechanical or hydraulic opening selected for the agreed production sequence
Access provisions for preparation, concrete placement, inspection, cleaning and maintenance
products.inputs: Approved component drawings, beam schedule, target casting cycle, dimensional tolerances, prestressing information where applicable, concrete placement and curing methods, production layout and handling plan.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing a project-specific precast beam and girder mould system

products.title: Box Girder Moulds
products.description: External and internal steel mould assemblies engineered around the approved geometry and casting method of precast box girders.
products.application: Box girder moulds support highway, railway, urban viaduct and long-span bridge projects using precast box-shaped superstructure elements. Web inclination, deck width, cell geometry, diaphragms, prestressing ducts, lifting provisions and casting orientation are reviewed before the mould is divided into practical bottom, side, end and internal-form assemblies.
performance: Steel contact surfaces shaped to the approved external and internal girder geometry
Mould segmentation planned around reinforcement installation, concrete access and demoulding clearance
Reference points, stops and locking devices for controlled repeat setup
Mechanical or hydraulic movement for selected side-form or internal-form functions where required
Workshop trial assembly and dimensional verification to an agreed inspection plan
products.inputs: Approved girder drawings, component schedule, casting orientation, prestressing and embedded-item details, target cycle, tolerance requirements, operating preference, yard layout and lifting method.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing an external and internal precast box girder mould system

products.title: Segmental Bridge Moulds
products.description: Short-line or long-line steel mould systems for project-controlled production of precast segmental bridge units.
products.application: Segmental bridge moulds are used in casting yards producing segments for span-by-span, balanced-cantilever and other approved erection methods. The mould concept follows the bridge alignment, segment family, casting curve, match-casting procedure, diaphragm and web arrangement, shear-key details, post-tensioning ducts and survey-control method.
performance: Bottom, side and bulkhead structures configured to the approved segment geometry
Fixed and adjustable references for the selected short-line or long-line method
Provisions for match-cast positioning and survey-control points
Interfaces for shear keys, ducts, embedded items and lifting provisions shown on approved drawings
Mechanical or hydraulic positioning functions selected for the agreed casting sequence
products.inputs: Segment drawings, bridge alignment data, casting and erection methods, segment schedule, tolerance basis, duct and embedded-item details, target cycle, yard arrangement and survey procedure.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing a short-line or long-line precast segmental bridge mould

products.title: Wall Panel Moulds
products.description: Horizontal or vertical steel mould arrangements for structural, façade, sandwich and project-defined precast wall panels.
products.application: Wall panel moulds serve residential, commercial and industrial building programmes that require repeated structural or architectural wall elements. Horizontal tables, battery-type arrangements or other project-specific concepts are selected from the panel geometry, surface requirements, insulation build-up where applicable, opening layout, embedded items and factory material flow.
performance: Flat or shaped contact surfaces developed from the approved panel drawings
Adjustable side rails, stops or inserts for an agreed panel family
Interfaces for openings, embedded items and insulation layers where specified
Support for the selected reinforcement, casting, vibration and curing sequence
Accessible surfaces for preparation, cleaning and routine inspection
products.inputs: Panel drawings and schedule, production orientation, thickness and opening ranges, surface finish, embedded-item and insulation details, target cycle, lifting method and factory layout.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing a precast concrete wall panel mould

products.title: Floor and Roof Slab Moulds
products.description: Steel casting tables and edge-form systems configured for solid, ribbed or other approved precast floor and roof slabs.
products.application: Floor and roof slab moulds are used in building-component factories producing repeated horizontal structural elements. The equipment concept is coordinated with slab dimensions, edge profiles, openings, cast-in items, reinforcement or prestressing where applicable, required surface orientation and the planned lifting and stacking method.
performance: Level steel casting surfaces sized for the approved slab family
Repositionable edge forms and inserts where controlled dimensional variation is required
Interfaces for openings, service penetrations and cast-in hardware shown on approved drawings
Compatibility with the selected concrete distribution, vibration and curing process
Reference features for repeat setup and routine dimensional inspection
products.inputs: Slab drawings, size and thickness schedule, edge details, opening and embedded-item plans, reinforcement or prestressing method, finish requirements, target cycle and handling arrangement.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing a precast floor and roof slab mould or casting table

products.title: Column and Building Beam Moulds
products.description: Adjustable steel mould systems for precast columns and building beams with project-defined sections, lengths and connection details.
products.application: These moulds are used for structural frames in industrial, commercial and multi-storey precast construction. The design basis includes column or beam cross-section, corbels and ledges, connection plates, reinforcement congestion, length variants, casting orientation and demoulding direction.
performance: Side, bottom and end forms shaped to approved structural profiles
Adjustable stops or end forms for an agreed range of component lengths
Local inserts for corbels, ledges and approved connection details
Locking and support arrangements based on the selected casting orientation
Access for reinforcement placement, concrete consolidation and safe demoulding planning
products.inputs: Structural component drawings, length schedule, corbel and connection details, reinforcement arrangement, tolerance basis, casting orientation, target cycle, lifting points and factory constraints.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing adjustable precast column and building beam moulds

products.title: Stair and Balcony Moulds
products.description: Project-specific mould systems for precast stair flights, landings, balcony slabs and related architectural components.
products.application: Stair and balcony moulds support building projects that need repeated components with controlled geometry, visible faces and connection details. The mould orientation and division are selected from riser and tread geometry, landing arrangement, balcony edge profile, drainage falls, inserts, finish requirements and handling method.
performance: Contact surfaces formed to approved stair, landing or balcony geometry
Adjustable end or side elements for an agreed family of variants
Provision for connection hardware, lifting anchors and project-defined recesses
Mould division planned for reinforcement access, casting and demoulding
Surface preparation and inspection access for visible concrete faces
products.inputs: Component drawings, variant schedule, visible-surface requirements, connection and lifting details, casting orientation, dimensional tolerances, production quantity and handling plan.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing precast concrete stair and balcony moulds

products.title: Tunnel Lining Segment Moulds
products.description: Steel mould systems for repeated production of project-defined precast tunnel lining segments and ring components.
products.application: Tunnel lining segment moulds are configured for the approved ring geometry, segment types, key segment, gasket grooves, bolt or dowel provisions, reinforcement cage, embedded items and curing process. They are used in controlled production facilities supplying metro, railway, road, water or utility tunnel projects.
performance: Machined or fabricated contact surfaces configured to the approved segment geometry
End and side arrangements for specified joint faces, grooves and connection provisions
Reference and locking features for repeat closure and setup
Compatibility with the agreed reinforcement, casting, vibration and curing workflow
Inspection access and identification provisions aligned with the project quality plan
products.inputs: Ring and segment drawings, segment schedule, joint and gasket details, connection provisions, reinforcement cage data, tolerance basis, curing method, target cycle and inspection requirements.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing a precast tunnel lining segment mould

products.title: Box Culvert Moulds
products.description: Internal and external mould systems for single-cell, multi-cell and project-defined precast box culvert units.
products.application: Box culvert moulds are used for drainage crossings, utility corridors, underpasses and other buried infrastructure. The design is coordinated with internal clear dimensions, wall and slab thickness, joint profile, cell arrangement, reinforcement access, casting orientation and lifting method.
performance: External panels and internal core sections configured to the approved culvert geometry
Collapsible, movable or fixed core concepts selected from demoulding clearance and cycle requirements
End-form provisions for approved joint profiles and dimensional variants
Support and locking systems based on the mould layout and concrete pressure basis
Access for reinforcement work, concrete placement, consolidation, cleaning and inspection
products.inputs: Culvert drawings, cell configuration, joint details, size schedule, reinforcement arrangement, casting orientation, target cycle, lifting method, yard layout and tolerance requirements.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing an internal and external precast box culvert mould

products.title: Underground Structure Moulds
products.description: Made-to-drawing mould systems for precast shafts, utility structures, galleries and other below-ground concrete components.
products.application: Underground structure moulds address components whose geometry does not fit a standard tunnel segment or culvert family. Typical applications may include shafts, utility galleries, access structures and project-defined underground modules, subject to confirmation from the approved design documents.
performance: Modular steel panels configured around the approved structural envelope
Internal cores, recess boxes and end forms planned for the required demoulding sequence
Interfaces for penetrations, cast-in parts, joints and lifting provisions
Mechanical or hydraulic assistance where justified by component size and operation
Assembly references and inspection points for controlled repeat production
products.inputs: Approved structural drawings, component schedule, penetrations and embedded-item details, joint design, casting and demoulding sequence, tolerance basis, lifting plan and site or factory constraints.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing a project-specific precast underground structure mould

products.title: Drainage Channel Moulds
products.description: Steel mould systems for open channels, U-shaped drains, trench units and related precast drainage components.
products.application: Drainage channel moulds support municipal roads, industrial sites, transport corridors and water-management works. The mould is configured from the channel cross-section, length, wall thickness, end joint, cover-seat or edge detail, embedded items and intended production method.
performance: Contact surfaces shaped to approved open-channel or trench geometry
Interchangeable end forms or inserts for an agreed dimensional family
Side-form opening selected for practical reinforcement access and demoulding
Defined support, alignment and locking points for repeat setup
Compatibility with the selected casting, vibration, curing and lifting process
products.inputs: Channel drawings, size schedule, joint and edge details, reinforcement information, tolerance requirements, production orientation, target cycle, lifting arrangement and yard layout.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing a precast drainage channel or trench mould

products.title: Manhole and Inspection Chamber Moulds
products.description: Core-and-shell mould systems for precast manholes, inspection chambers, bases, risers and project-defined access units.
products.application: These moulds are used by drainage and utility-component producers manufacturing circular, rectangular or project-specific access chambers. The configuration follows internal and external geometry, base channels, wall penetrations, joint profiles, riser sizes, lifting details and the intended casting orientation.
performance: External shells and internal cores configured to approved chamber geometry
Opening boxes and inserts for documented pipe entries and connection details
Core withdrawal concept selected from geometry, clearance and operating sequence
End and joint forms for compatible bases, risers or cover units where required
Cleaning, inspection and maintenance access incorporated into the operating layout
products.inputs: Chamber drawings, base and riser schedule, penetration details, joint profiles, casting orientation, tolerance basis, target cycle, lifting method and factory handling constraints.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing a precast manhole and inspection chamber mould

products.title: Road Barrier and Kerb Moulds
products.description: Repeat-production steel moulds for project-defined concrete road barriers, median units, kerbs and edge components.
products.application: Road barrier and kerb moulds serve highway, urban road, bridge and traffic-management projects. The equipment is developed around the approved barrier or kerb profile, length, end connection, drainage feature, embedded item, surface requirement and production quantity.
performance: Steel contact surfaces configured to the approved safety-barrier or kerb profile
End forms and inserts for documented connections, recesses and lifting points
Single- or multi-cavity arrangements considered against production quantity and handling method
Opening and locking sequence designed for practical demoulding
Reference points for repeat setup and routine dimensional checks
products.inputs: Approved profile drawings, length and variant schedule, end connections, embedded and lifting details, finish requirements, production quantity, target cycle and handling arrangement.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing precast concrete road barrier and kerb moulds

products.title: Concrete Pipe Moulds
products.description: Inner-core and outer-shell mould assemblies for project-defined precast concrete pipes and compatible joint profiles.
products.application: Concrete pipe moulds are configured for drainage, sewer, water-management and utility applications. Diameter, wall thickness, pipe length, socket and spigot geometry, reinforcement arrangement, casting orientation, compaction method and lifting process determine the mould concept.
performance: Inner and outer mould surfaces configured to approved pipe dimensions
End rings or joint formers for specified socket, spigot or project-defined connections
Core and shell opening arrangements selected for the agreed production process
Alignment and locking features for controlled assembly
Handling and maintenance provisions coordinated with the factory workflow
products.inputs: Pipe drawings, diameter and length schedule, wall thickness, joint profile, reinforcement method, casting and compaction process, tolerance basis, target cycle and handling equipment.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing an inner-core and outer-shell precast concrete pipe mould

products.title: Adjustable and Modular Moulds
products.description: Reconfigurable steel mould systems for an approved family of precast components with controlled dimensional or geometric variants.
products.application: Adjustable and modular moulds are considered when a production programme contains related components that share a controlled geometry or interface basis. The useful adjustment range, module boundaries and changeover sequence are defined from the complete component schedule rather than assumed to be universal.
performance: Repositionable panels, end forms, inserts or support modules within an approved adjustment range
Reference marks, stops and locking positions for defined configurations
Demountable connections planned for the expected changeover and transport sequence
Replaceable wear or contact elements where appropriate to the agreed design
Configuration records and inspection points aligned with the production quality plan
products.inputs: Complete component family drawings, variant matrix, production quantities, permitted adjustment range, tolerance requirements, changeover target, casting process, handling method and available floor space.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing an adjustable and modular precast concrete mould system

products.title: Hydraulic and Special-Shaped Moulds
products.description: Project-specific mould systems combining non-standard component geometry with mechanical or hydraulic positioning where justified.
products.application: Hydraulic and special-shaped moulds address components with complex faces, constrained demoulding paths, large movable panels or operating sequences that benefit from powered assistance. Hydraulic movement is applied only to defined opening, closing, positioning or stripping functions and does not replace the required locking, support and safety controls.
performance: Steel contact surfaces developed directly from approved three-dimensional or sectional geometry
Mould segmentation planned around reinforcement access, concrete placement and demoulding paths
Hydraulic cylinders or mechanical drives selected for documented movement functions where required
Positive supports and locking devices separated from powered movement where the design basis requires
Maintenance access, hose routing, control interfaces and trial operation included in the agreed scope
products.inputs: Approved component model and drawings, movement and demoulding study, concrete pressure basis, target cycle, hydraulic or mechanical preference, control and safety requirements, factory utilities, layout and handling plan.
products.imageAlt: Placeholder view of fabricated steel formwork representing a hydraulic and special-shaped precast concrete mould system
